    14  This file defines the Vietoris topology on the types of compact subsets and nonempty compact subsets
    15  of a topological space. The Vietoris topology is generated by sets of the form
    16  $\{K \mid K \subseteq U\}$ and $\{K \mid K \cap U \ne \emptyset\}$, where $U$ is an open subset of
    17  the underlying space.
    18  
    19  ## Implementation notes
    20  
    21  Rather than defining the topology directly on `TopologicalSpace.Compacts α`, we first define
    22  `TopologicalSpace.vietoris α` on `Set α`, then we take the subspace topology on
    23  `TopologicalSpace.Compacts α` and `TopologicalSpace.NonemptyCompacts α`. This approach will
    24  let us reuse several results if a type of closed sets equipped with the Vietoris topology is
    25  defined in the future.
    26  
    27  Note that we do not equip `TopologicalSpace.Closeds α` with the Vietoris topology. When `α` is a
    28  metric space, `TopologicalSpace.Closeds α` is equipped with the Hausdorff metric, which is generally
    29  incompatible with the Vietoris topology.
    30  
    31  ## References
    32  
    33  * [Ernest Michael, *Topologies on spaces of subsets*][michael1951]
